name: workflows
description: Developer workflow automation — turn requirements (PRD, spec, notes) into a structured backlog and architecture doc, create custom Claude Code agents, ship git changes end-to-end (branch, Conventional Commit, push, PR), implement, test + review features via stack-aware developer, tester and reviewer agents backed by React/.NET convention skills and universal coding principles, and orchestrate a test-first develop→test→review pipeline that drives changes from red to green before review.

interface.shortDescription: Plan requirements into a backlog, create agents, ship git changes end-to-end, implement, test + review features with stack-aware conventions, and run a test-first develop→test→review pipeline.
interface.longDescription: Developer workflow automation skills and agents: turn requirements (PRD, spec, design notes) into a structured backlog of epics/features/tasks plus an architecture document before implementation, scaffold and refine custom Claude Code agent definitions, ship working-tree changes from dirty tree to open PR (branch naming, Conventional Commits, base-branch sync, push, PR/MR), implement, test, and review coding tasks via stack-aware developer, tester, and reviewer agents that route to React/TypeScript or .NET/C# convention skills plus universal coding principles (DRY, KISS, YAGNI), and orchestrate a test-first feature pipeline that drives a task from failing tests (RED) to a passing implementation (GREEN) to review, running parallel developers on disjoint file-ownership lanes when a task splits cleanly.
